pages.text: This version replaces the 0.4 $(italic)OmniFlash-72B$() / $(italic)LegacyLlama-8B$() placeholders with real families, split by $(bold)deployment camp$():$(li)$(#0E7490)Open camp$() (LOCAL): deployed into the MoE router, occupies local VRAM, $(bold)zero Tokens$().$(li)$(#0E7490)Closed camp$() (API): dialled through the satellite station, billed in Tokens, $(bold)zero local VRAM$().

pages.title: Open · Qwen 9187 Pro-Max-Ultra
pages.text: $(bold)16 TB$() plus $(bold)+4 TB / +4 CWU/t$() per LoRA, up to four slots.$(br2)$(li)Bound to the $(item)local fallback gateway$() its fallback is only $(bold)1.5×$() slower — the model-less case is 4×, a very visible difference.$(li)Mining and chemical runs $(bold)both skip the overfitting penalty$() across domains.$(li)It runs on IV air-cooled rooms, not just liquid cabinets.

pages.title: Open · DeepSeek-V6767 Flash / Pro
pages.text: $(bold)Flash 32 TB$() / $(bold)Pro 64 TB$(), with DeepThink reserving another $(bold)+16 TB$().$(br2)$(li)Both use MoE sparse activation: only $(bold)25%$() of the nominal CWU/t is billed, built for steady high-concurrency runs.$(li)$(bold)Pro$() additionally unlocks $(bold)DeepThink$(): by-products forced to 100%.$(li)Pro is also the model that hits the switch bandwidth ceiling first, tripping $(bold)503 Server Busy$().

pages.title: Open · GLM-2333 Flash / Max
pages.text: $(bold)Flash 24 TB / 4 CWU/t$(), $(bold)Max 48 TB / 8 CWU/t$().$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Flash$(): machine-room inspection — below $(bold)20%$() stored energy the room auto-sleeps protectively, and maintenance is $(bold)waived$().$(li)$(bold)Max$(): top-tier $(bold)agent tool calling$() — it stops and restarts associated multiblocks automatically, idling on jam or starvation and pulling them back up on recovery. The groundwork for a fully lights-out plant.

pages.title: Closed · the Three Geminis
pages.text: All three dial out through the API station and $(bold)occupy no local VRAM$().$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Gemini-Titanium-4.0$(): carries the $(bold)Leaving Soon$() retirement countdown and refuses new rounds once expired.$(li)$(bold)Gemini-Platinum$(): chemical noise suppression — cheaper reagents.$(li)$(bold)Gemini-Xenon$(): the heavy inert gas route, $(bold)hard zero hallucination$() and fully $(bold)waived maintenance$().

pages.title: Closed · GPT-1145 Multiverse & Grok-420
pages.text: $(bold)GPT-1145 Multiverse$(): the $(bold)highest Token price$() buys the best reagent savings and by-product bonus. Whitelisted dangerous chemistry rounds trip its $(bold)moral refusal$() and stop the machine until a $(item)Jailbreak Patch Card$() is inserted.$(br2)$(bold)Grok-420$(): $(bold)completely uncensored$() — it runs the dangerous rounds with no jailbreak card, cheaper than GPT. The price is that its $(bold)rain / thunder attenuation and duration penalty are doubled$(). Great in clear weather, hopeless in a storm.
